properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto-js-wasm ships TripleDES as first-party public API: JS+WASM implementation in src/encryption/tripledes.js (incl. loadWasm), exported from src/index.js, typed in types/index.d.ts, exercised by the repo's own test suites. Sweet32-vulnerable 64-bit block cipher offered to every consumer of the package.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto-js-wasm ships RC4 as first-party public API: JS+WASM implementation in src/encryption/rc4.js, a dedicated Rust-to-WASM crate at rust/rc4, exported from src/index.js, declared in types/index.d.ts and package.json, exercised by test suites.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: This repo is @originjs/crypto-js-wasm, a crypto-js-compatible library (JS API over Rust→WASM cores). DES is a shipped, advertised algorithm (package.json keyword, DESAlgo in src/encryption/tripledes.js, rust/des WASM crate); these 33 test sites are the vendored crypto-js parity suite exercising that shipped cipher against the reference implementation. Changeable here: the library owner controls what algorithms ship.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto-js-wasm ships SHA-1 as first-party public API (JS+WASM hasher in src/algo/hash/sha1.js, exported C.SHA1 from src/index.js, typed in types/index.d.ts), declares it in package.json, and the Rust rsa crate depends on the `sha1` crate (rust/rsa/Cargo.toml) for RSA PKCS1v15/OAEP digest support. Collision-broken hash offered to every consumer; changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: MD5 is a shipped, advertised library algorithm (src/algo/hash/md5.js over rust/md5 WASM, package.json keyword) kept for crypto-js compatibility. Beyond these test sites, MD5 is also the default EvpKDF hasher (src/encryption/evpkdf.js:45) and a selectable RSA-OAEP/PSS/sign hash option (rust/rsa/src/utils.rs). Collision-broken; retained only for API parity. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto-js-wasm ships HMAC-MD5 as first-party public API: HmacMD5 helper bound to the MD5 hasher in src/algo/hash/md5.js:156, exported from src/index.js, typed in types/index.d.ts, exercised by test suites (RFC 2202 vectors). A MAC over a collision-broken hash is still practically sound for key-secured use, but it is deprecated everywhere; changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECB is a shipped, selectable block-cipher mode across the library's ciphers (AES, DES, 3DES, Blowfish via rust/ crates; src/mode/mode-ecb.js is the generic mode class exported as mode.ECB). Same plaintext block → same ciphertext block; kept for crypto-js API parity. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: EvpKDF is a shipped crypto-js-compatible algorithm (src/encryption/evpkdf.js, exported as EvpKDF/EvpKDFAlgo). Its defaults are the OpenSSL legacy: MD5 hasher, 1 iteration — used by PasswordBasedCipher/OpenSSLKdf (src/core/cipher-core.js) for passphrase-based encryption in OpenSSL format. Weak-by-design KDF kept for crypto-js API compatibility.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: First-party RSA implementation shipped as public API of crypto-js-wasm: JS wrapper class in src/encryption/rsa.js around a Rust-to-WASM crate at rust/rsa (RustCrypto `rsa`). Full Shor-vulnerable surface: keygen (RsaPrivateKey::new, default 2048 bits per DEFAULT_RSA_KEY_SIZE in rsa.js:17), encryption/decryption (OAEP default, PKCS1v15 optional) and signing (PSS default, PKCS1v15 optional), with hash options sha256(default)/md5/sha1/sha224/sha384/sha512/ripemd160. Key size 2048 is classically adeq

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Test-only CMAC extension: artjomb's crypto-js CMAC/OMAC1 implementation embedded in the test file and registered onto the library object, used with known-answer vectors to exercise the shipped AES (WASM). Not part of the shipped library surface (src/), but real cryptography in the repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto-js-wasm ships HMAC-SHA-1 as first-party public API: HmacSHA1 helper bound to the SHA-1 hasher (src/algo/hash/sha1.js:134), exported from src/index.js:159, typed in types/index.d.ts:1731, exercised by tests. Sound as a MAC today but deprecated; changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The library's shipped PBKDF2 default is hardened: keySize 128-bit, hasher SHA256, iterations 250000 (src/algo/pbkdf2/pbkdf2.js:37-39, the CVE-2023-46233 fix per CHANGELOG). The three low-iteration sites are test code, not shipped defaults: test/algo.pbkdf2.test.js:91/98 use 50 iterations because the expected values are RFC 3962 Kerberos vectors, and test/evpkdf.profile.test.js:10 profiles EVP_BytesToKey (EvpKDF, a different KDF) at 20 iterations. Kept as real KDF invocations with low iteration c

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Transitive dev-only lockfile dependency (dev: true): sshpk 1.16.1 (http-signature tooling) requires bcrypt-pbkdf ^1.0.0, which in turn requires tweetnacl. Ships OpenSSH's bcrypt_pbkdf KDF implementation into the dev node_modules only; no direct use in src/ or rust/. The dependency inventory should record it; not part of the published package.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 capability enters the tree only via tweetnacl@0.14.5 (package-lock.json:7036-7038), a transitive dev-dependency of bcrypt — no runtime or first-party call sites in this codebase. Dependency-inventory presence: what the build ships, not what the application uses. Shor-vulnerable signature scheme (migration: ML-DSA-65) sitting in the dev tree.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X25519 capability enters the tree only via tweetnacl@0.14.5 (transitive dev-dependency of bcrypt); no first-party call sites. Shor-vulnerable key agreement (migration: ML-KEM-768); dev-tree presence only.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The library's strong MAC family: HmacSHA256 (src/algo/hash/sha256.js:127), HmacSHA384 (sha384.js:70), HmacSHA512 (sha512.js:162), each a first-party WASM-capable helper exported from src/index.js and typed in types/index.d.ts, exercised with RFC 4231/2202 vectors. Post-quantum posture is good (HMAC-SHA-256+ survives Grover at current security levels).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PBKDF2 is a shipped crypto-js-compatible KDF (src/algo/pbkdf2/pbkdf2.js, exported as PBKDF2/PBKDF2Algo, HMAC-SHA1 default in crypto-js lineage; RFC 6070 vectors in tests). The test iteration counts (1-1200, incl. 50) are standard RFC test vectors, not production configuration. Quantum-safe (symmetric).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 is a shipped library algorithm (src/algo/hash/sha256.js over rust/sha256 WASM); these parity-test sites exercise it. Quantum-safe.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto-js 4.1.1 is a devDependency used as the reference implementation in the parity test suite; the library's own AES ships in rust/aes (WASM) behind src/encryption/aes.js and is exported as AES/AESAlgo. AES itself is quantum-safe (Grover margin); its ECB mode is tracked separately (ALG-136e45af).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The sha2 0.10.2 crate (RustCrypto) is the SHA-2 family implementation inside the WASM RSA module, providing SHA-224/256/384/512 for RSA-OAEP and RSA-PSS/PKCS1v15 padding (rust/rsa/src/utils.rs:21-25, 31-35, 41-45), including the API defaults SHA-256 (src/encryption/rsa.js:21). Quantum-safe hashes.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-384/512 are shipped library algorithms (src/algo/hash/sha384.js, sha512.js over rust/sha512 WASM); these tests exercise them against the reference implementation. Quantum-safe hashes (Grover only).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: XSalsa20-Poly1305 (tweetnacl's crypto_secretbox) is the strongest authenticated-encryption primitive in the tree — but it enters only via tweetnacl@0.14.5, a transitive dev-dependency of bcrypt, with no first-party call sites. Post-quantum-relevant only via Grover's quadratic speedup against its 256-bit key, which is still fine.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The library's randomness source (WordArray.random, which generates IVs/keys for all of crypto-js-wasm's cipher helpers): cryptoSecureRandomInt() uses browser crypto.getRandomValues or Node crypto.randomBytes and THROWS if native crypto is unavailable — no Math.random fallback (an improvement over upstream crypto-js). Genuinely secure randomness; this is the RNG posture consumers inherit.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Transitive dev-only lockfile dependency: sshpk 1.16.1 (http-signature tooling) requires tweetnacl ~0.14.0; bcrypt-pbkdf also requires it. tweetnacl 0.14.x brings Ed25519, X25519, XSalsa20-Poly1305 and SHA-512 capabilities into the dev node_modules only (covered by the Ed25519/X25519/XSalsa20 objects) — no direct use in src/ or rust/, not part of the published package.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: This repository IS a crypto library itself (@originjs/crypto-js-wasm, an ESM+WASM alternative to crypto-js), so the crypto-js relationship is twofold: the repo is the crypto-js API surface re-implemented, and upstream crypto-js ^4.1.1 is a devDependency (package.json:64) used by test/crypto-js-test for differential testing of the WASM build against upstream. Note crypto-js 4.1.1 predates the 4.2.0 PBKDF2 hardening (CVE-2023-46233), though here it is dev-only. The production dependencies are add/

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RustCrypto sha2 crate — the SHA-2 provider inside the WASM RSA module. Used for RSA-OAEP hash and PSS/PKCS1v15 sign hashing (utils.rs); the API default hash is SHA-256. Quantum-safe provider.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RustCrypto md-5 crate — enables MD5 as a selectable hash for RSA-OAEP encryption, PKCS1v15 signing and PSS signing in the WASM RSA module (rust/rsa/src/utils.rs:20,30,40; JS selector src/encryption/rsa.js:25). MD5 is collision-broken; this option exists only for crypto-js/legacy interop. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RustCrypto sha1 crate — enables SHA-1 as a selectable hash for RSA-OAEP, PKCS1v15-sign and PSS in the WASM RSA module (rust/rsa/src/utils.rs:21,31,41; JS selector src/encryption/rsa.js:26). SHA-1 is collision-broken; option kept for legacy interop. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RustCrypto rsa 0.6.1 crate — the RSA implementation behind the library's shipped RSA API (src/encryption/rsa.js wraps RsaPrivate/RsaPublic wasm classes). Keygen uses rand::ThreadRng seeded via getrandom's js feature (crypto.getRandomValues / Node randomBytes) — a CSPRNG. Supports 2048-bit default (rsa.js docstring), PEM/DER PKCS#8, OAEP/PKCS1v15 encrypt, PSS/PKCS1v15 sign. Quantum-vulnerable (Shor); the whole RSA surface migrates to ML-KEM/ML-DSA.
